title: Research: compose L248/L253/L259 schedules on PR1263 word (no new κ)
body:
## Result

Finite scalar-circuit composition; no new κ claim and no selected-supplier change.

This packages the PR1353 L248, PR1350 L253, and PR1385 L259 time-varying gauges on the same PR1263 frozen 218-helper word. The seed-27 index anchors the question at L253. Each schedule is mapped back to the common ordered source-ADD stream. Their incident supports have sizes 71, 96, and 144; every pairwise intersection is empty in both orientations. The scalar objective therefore separates into the three pinned one-coordinate objectives, with separate per-helper scale transitions and restoration.

The composed word saves 494 complex primitives per orientation over PR1263’s constant-gauge word:

- Forward: 136,002 → 135,508 complex primitives; 67,754 real primitives.
- Backward: 136,018 → 135,524 complex primitives; 67,762 real primitives.

The paid recursive profile is unchanged, the inherited 192-bit charge is preserved, all 712 formal columns replay, and all helpers/centers restore. This is exact composition of these three pinned coordinate optima with all other PR1263 gauges held fixed; it is not a search over other helpers or schedule families.

## Reproduce

From the repository root:

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/k8-l248-l253-l259-temporal-composition-seed27/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/k8-l248-l253-l259-temporal-composition-seed27 --check-only
```

Expected replay:

```text
PASS_COMPLEX_L248_L253_L259_TEMPORAL_COMPOSITION
forward support 71 96 144 shared {'248_253': [], '248_259': [], '253_259': []} complex_primitives 135508 columns 712 no_new_kappa
backward support 71 96 144 shared {'248_253': [], '248_259': [], '253_259': []} complex_primitives 135524 columns 712 no_new_kappa
```

Both commands pass locally on CPython 3.14.7. Python 3.12 is unavailable here, so the registered Python 3.12 replay remains pending. Source pins and complete invoices are in `research/k8-l248-l253-l259-temporal-composition-seed27/`.

## Overlap and attribution

The final refresh covered 869 open PRs and 128 discussions with complete pagination and no warnings. PR1376 is the exact L248/L253 pair predecessor; PR1385 supplies the separate L259 schedule. PR1397 studies L225/L350/L367 on the original PR1094 word, while PR1398 studies one L284 schedule on the PR1263 word; neither composes this pinned triple. The seed claim and result are recorded at [discussion #1163](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1163#discussioncomment-18911723).

Credit Philipp / @mightyOil for PR1263 and Cinna Davis / @1337isnot1337 for PR1350, PR1353, PR1376, and PR1385. Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no independent human review is claimed. New material is Apache-2.0.

## Limits

The selected record remains conditional κ = 0.001672660197076918. This finite scalar construction has not been admitted through the native complex supplier/controller or a whole-hosted invoice and does not change the selected recursive profile, κ, or theorem assumptions.
